novelty.justification: The novelty route is a mechanism/measurement claim: a "compact, language-agnostic concept subspace concentrated in the middle transformer layers" that can be causally used to "read/write concepts regardless of input language." Searches using “multilingual transformer shared concept subspace,” “interlingual semantic subspace middle layers,” and “cross-lingual concept activation steering” identify close precedents in High-Dimensional Interlingual Representations of Large Language Models (2025), which explicitly identifies shared interlingual semantic and fragmented components, and Wave to Interlingua (2024), which reports a shared semantic subspace; language-specific-neuron studies also already place language-selective representations mainly in the first and last layers. Adding an invariance projection, variance decomposition, and causal cross-language concept steering is a non-trivial but natural extension combining established subspace isolation and activation-intervention ideas, rather than a new core relationship or paradigm.
